Ines Okafor was the only passenger on the ferry to Harrow Quay. Ines Okafor was tasked with becoming the new keeper of the Salt Ledger.

Tobiah Wren informed Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been gone for three weeks. Tobiah Wren warned Ines Okafor to keep the brass key off the ledger and away from the council. The woman named Mara Venn emerged from the harbour office at the base of the Lamp House.

Mara Venn left Ines Okafor with the lamp and descended the stairs without speaking further. What does Mara Venn know regarding the missing pages from the Salt Ledger?

Ines Okafor was the only passenger on the ferry to Harrow Quay. Aldous Brandt was the previous keeper of the Salt Ledger. Ines Okafor was trying to find anyone who had worked with Aldous Brandt.

Tobiah Wren informed Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been gone for three weeks. Tobiah Wren gave Ines Okafor a small brass key that Aldous Brandt had given him. Tobiah Wren warned Ines Okafor to keep the brass key off the ledger and away from the council. Mara Venn led Ines Okafor to the archive where the Salt Ledger was located. Ines Okafor discovered that the spring pages were torn out of the Salt Ledger. Mara Venn stated that she knew nothing about the missing pages. Ines Okafor spoke with Mara Lisle, who worked in the net loft. Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping in his last month. Mara Lisle mentioned that Aldous Brandt was counting barrels at night. Ines Okafor counted the salt over a period of four days. Ines Okafor discovered a discrepancy between the ledger and the carters' receipts.

Ines Okafor discarded the printed handbill into the stove after finding it nonsensical. Ines Okafor found a printed handbill pasted over the margin of the November page. What was the purpose of the printed handbill found by Ines Okafor?

Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping in his last month. Mara Lisle mentioned that Aldous Brandt was counting barrels at night. Ines Okafor dismissed the printed handbill as a prank from the dock boys. Ines Okafor asked Mara Venn to open the salt warehouse for counting the barrels. Ines Okafor heard the street door open and someone climbing the stairs late at night. The archive lamp went out while Ines Okafor was in the room. Ines Okafor did not sleep after the events of the previous night.

Dr Pike made Ines Okafor sit and listened to the whole story with his hands folded. What does Dr Pike intend to do with the receipts Ines Okafor offers him?

Ines Okafor was the only passenger on the ferry to Harrow Quay. Aldous Brandt was the previous keeper of the Salt Ledger. Mara Venn was the Harbourmaster who met Ines Okafor. Tobiah Wren was the ferryman who transported Ines Okafor to the island. Ines Okafor was trying to count the salt to verify the ledger's records. Ines Okafor was trying to carry her salt count tally to the council the next morning.

Tobiah Wren informed Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been gone for three weeks. Tobiah Wren gave Ines Okafor a small brass key that Aldous Brandt had given him. Mara Venn led Ines Okafor to the archive where the Salt Ledger was located. Ines Okafor discovered that the spring pages were torn out of the Salt Ledger. Mara Venn stated that she knew nothing about the missing pages. Ines Okafor spoke with Mara Lisle, who worked in the net loft. Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping in his last month. Mara Lisle mentioned that Aldous Brandt was counting barrels at night. Ines Okafor discovered a printed handbill pasted over the November page of the ledger. Ines Okafor dismissed the printed handbill as a prank from the dock boys. Ines Okafor asked Mara Venn to open the salt warehouse for counting the barrels. Ines Okafor copied her salt count onto a single sheet, noting forty barrels in the book and sixty-four on the receipts. Ines Okafor heard the street door open and someone climbing the stairs late at night. The archive lamp went out while Ines Okafor was in the room. Ines Okafor did not sleep after the events in the archive. Ines Okafor searched the archive at first light, believing her tally might be misplaced. Dr Pike located Ines Okafor on the tower steps and expressed his concern. Dr Pike listened to Ines Okafor's entire account while keeping his hands folded. Dr Pike mentioned the scent of tar and juniper when speaking to Ines Okafor.

Dr Pike offered Ines Okafor a kind and sensible suggestion regarding the receipts. Dr Pike requested the receipts from Ines Okafor to secure them tonight. Dr Pike stated that he possessed a strongbox in the dispensary where nobody searches a doctor. What will happen to the receipts after Ines Okafor gives them to Dr Pike?
